text: This place was amazing the food was super good or nachos were late so they were comped  and they brought out churros for kerri birthday real nice people highly recommend it

Been here maybe 5 times over the last year and a half always for breakfast.
Food is ok. It certainly meets standard diner style quality.
Service not so much! On our last visit we waited a l o n g time for our waitress to take our order and then l o n g e r to receive our food
Attention to our needs such as a simple request for more coffee and and water went unmet until we had almost finished our breakfast.
And NO they we're not that busy!
Ok food and lousy service just doesn't cut it. I'm local and there are too many other great places to eat breakfast on St Pete Beach.
Goodbye Skidders!
Stock is consistently good, with great service, and very timely delivery. I can count on this place when I need to warm up with a nice pho.

The food is good but my Uber eats order was missing a gyro. When I called, he said the order was only for 1 gyro and 1 fries. But somehow I was charged $22.90 by Uber eats? The order clearly shows 2 gyros. So....I'll be trying other places.

It was crowded when we came but worth the wait for breakfast.
At least they served drinks on the 2nd floor with a bar as we waited for breakfast.
So many selections on the menu. 
You've got to have their praline bacon, basically it's sweet crispy bacon. 
Beware if you're a diabetic :p

I went after their special menu dish for breakfast. Got the soft shell crab. Really enjoyed the dressing they had on the crab. Ate the whole darn thing.

I definitely need to come back to try their other dishes.

Fantastic addition to the Phoenixville area.  They  have a fried fish in tomato sauce, covered in peppers and onions that is absolute perfection.  Today was my first time trying the cheesy baked potato and it was equally stellar.  The food is quick, fresh and tasty and the everyone who works there is super nice. 

If you're in the area definitely stop by!

I couldn't even wait to post this review. The food is so amazing and I'm still eating while posting this review. I had the crabbie benny which is a crab benedict with a side of buffalo chicken grits and I also ordered a side of the sautéed spinach which I HIGHLY recommend. The food was amazing and tasted so fresh. Kristine was our server and she was amazing from start to end. I didn't like that the check got dropped before we were done eating but I don't know if that's a company policy or not, either way it comes off a little rude; however, that didn't make me take away a star or say anything bad about our server. I highly recommend this place because the food and mimosas are great.

This is our solid go to choice for oysters, fried clam strips, sports and solid service. Samantha is our favorite just a note that it's only beer and wine though.
If you like chicken wings, did I mention they have about 100 combinations of sauces/flavors ! To die for!
Amazing,delicious, tasty treats. His seasonal buns are exceptional.  Loved,the peach,and bananas foster. The Carmelita  bars are my favorite.

Every time we order from here,  there is something wrong.   They have lost our order on more than one occasion.  Then they either forget a part of the order or something is messed  up.  Sometimes it's both.  I suggest checking over your take out order prior to leaving because you can't rely on them to actually get your order right.

Best steak ever. Best experience ever. The 31oz porterhouse was to die for. It feed me for the following next two days. The waiter never said the word no or I can't. So accommodating! Wine was amazing

This spot is really good as far as being authentic Indian cuisine goes. I ordered the tandoori wings and chicken 65 as appetizer and I have to say it was made to perfection. I highly recommend them for starters. Also ordered the chicken tikka dish and also the grilled lamb. Both were really tasty and spices were on point. The nan was an extra touch. Overall , I am glad that I was able to finally stop by and check out the spot. You guys need to check it out and taste the authentic indian cuisine for yourself. Also, friendly staff which is always a plus

Very inconsistent with there portions. One day got a cheesesteak loaded with steak. The other day it barely reached the end of the bread. For $12 you should fill the bread full like I had on my first flem. The bread was hard and crunchy too.
Jackie is best the server I've ever had very attentive and recommended some amazing food

Very disappointing experience. 
The food was okay. The short rib was our favorite. The duck pate was barely tasty though the garlic butter was really interesting but took over all the papillary experience.
Mostly, we were very disappointed by the service. We felt rushed. We were done in 40min. For a 3 courses menu that was clearly too fast.
There are so many other restaurants in the city. I do not recommend to stop here unless someone else is paying for you.
This is one of the best places for sushi takeout on the Main Line. The Barry Roll was so good (mainly all fish and no rice). I will very likely crave it until I order from them again!
Well , managed, still good protocols in place with the Covid going on thumbs up food is still good will be back again thanks.

absolutely the best flavored wings. spicy lemon grass had the tangy lemon flavor with a  hint of spice. the fish sauce wings  were an umami bomb. but the best thing was the mixture of the 2 sauces on the bottom of the plate. succulent juicy and delicious. 
the spring rolls were freshly made and big and plump. the were some of the best  that i have tried. 
the pho was good. i have had better but they put alot of noodles and meat. really good but not great.
the sevice was great. even with covid. they require mask to enter and they also wear them for your benefit.

I haven't had a big pizza from there but I did try the 7 inch. It was pretty delicious only complaint is the burn cheese around the edges. Also the toppings were piled high but that also had its disadvantage. I felt like some of the toppings were a little cooler than the rest. I have tried the breadsticks and cheese and the bread sticks were absolutely amazing. The cheese sauce was also on point. I believe it was a jalapeño nacho. Which made it better. Last but not least I have tried the calzone. Now this thing was absolutely a 5/5! It was huge! The crust on it is perfect. And made to your absolute liking.

I've been going to China Doll since I was little, 20+ years and it's still one of my favorite places! 
I love seafood, so I love how their fried rice and egg rolls have shrimp and they're so good! Their plates are a good size, and I've never been disappointed with anything I've tried there. It's always delicious. 
I live in Texas now, but I make sure to visit almost every time I go home to New Orleans

Bossie's is our favorite splurge. They have some of the best donuts I've ever eaten and we have so many favorites that the other night we simply ordered 4 donuts for dinner since we couldn't decide which one to get. We like their main dishes, too - the chicken, veggie platter, and fries are all fantastic.

Bottom Line: I only wanted to eat half of the sandwich but the sandwich CHANGED MY MIND.

I have to provide an update here as these guys have brought their game WAY up for COVID.

I went to meet my wife and daughter at the playground and she wanted food from this spot.

I got a PBJ for the daughter and the wife got the bacon sandwich.

I ordered the fully loaded Italian (and FYI, DONT WAIT to eat this one.  It needs to be eaten within 30 mins or its just a pile of mush).  It was huge and I figured that I would have the second half for dinner.  

Well done, guys.  The service was impeccable, the food was good... and as I always say, effort shows and they really showed some effort!
I couldn't imagine visiting any other place on National Gyro Day. The Classic Gyro was delicious!  The staff was polite and fast.
Great service, atmosphere and food! Came before a Blues game and was exactly what I was looking for! Easy parking on the street and great beer specials!

I visited this Buffalo Wild Wings location earlier this week. I was shocked by the disrespect the manager Eric showed to my wife and I. When inquiring about why our wings had taken nearly 40 minutes, he told my wife and I to "deal with it, because that is how long the kitchen is taking today". Showing a clear lack of sympathy and a complete disregard for our time, Eric proceeded to storm off in anger. It horrified me that someone like this could be a manager in the customer service industry. Rather than offering us any sort of discount, or even just a simple apology, he acted disgusted that we would even question how long our 2 snack size boneless wings were taking. Will not be back to this location of Buffalo Wild Wings. I have never written a review on Yelp before, but this awful experience inspired me to download the app.
Love their brunch! Egg benedict and coffee taste good. Best in Philly! The price is reasonable, food was good, service also good. But very crowded and noisy.
We ordered the bowl of Chili, buffalo wings and chicken nachos. Our entrée were good and the service was nice.

very disappointing meal bordering on gross. Our nachos were soggy (not a single crispy tortilla chip in the whole plate!) and cold, the bahn mi bread soaked in grease from the pork, and my "half price" classic cocktail was billed at full price ($12). We would have told the waitress, but she never even checked on us and did not ask when she dropped off the bill. (Maybe she knew?) We will not be back.

Ok beer selection. Food was pretty good but way overpriced for what it was. The service was not good. We felt very rushed and the waitress told us that we needed to close out with her, whether we wanted to order more food and drink or not (which we did). That has never happened to me before in my life. Having worked as a waiter before, I can't imaging being that rude to a guest. I saw her saying the same thing to other tables and each table looked offended. After she awkwardly stood there waiting for us to pay, she left and came back with our cards. We paid and sat a little while longer only to see that she was sitting at the bar drinking with her friends. Extremely unprofessional and bad service. I used to frequent this place but I'll think twice before coming back.

LOVE LOVE LOVE! My first time here & could not be more pleased.  Looking at the menu it seemed similar to so many other local places....but no! Upon arrival was greeted Immediately. Didn't have a reservation so I went to the bar for a drink first. Bartender was amazingly lovely & extremely accommodating. She even took care of me when I moved to a table.  That's great service!

 Large portions of tasty happiness.  Not sure I have ever seen a larger portion of short ribs in a restaurant.  Broccolini was also wonderful, as were the scallops.  Tried the "hot" fried cheese as an appetizer since it was interesting sounding.  Definitely interesting & quite good.  Amazing value for your money which is hard to come by in Nashville. It's not something I look for or really too concerned about, but refreshing to see.  

In a city with a dynamically changing food scene I think this restaurant has some serious long term staying power.  At least I hope so.  Will definitely be going back soon.

By far the best most authentic cultural food I've tasted. I'm from the Bay Area and I thought I had tasted good Pakistani food, until I found this place. But unfortunately this is not close to home. I definitely look forward to taking another trip to Reno, I hope the owner can bring this secret to the Bay Area. Great food, great service!
The tuna poboy is the best of all worlds. The sushi-poboy combo is amazingly delicious. I genuinely dream about this poboy... it's that good.

Everything about this restaurant was a win. I give it only 4/5 stars because my partner wasn't as impressed with the food as I was (I chock it up to his less than refined taste buds), but I thought the food and service were top notch. We came for restaurant week. $35 for a three-course meal that had us loosening our belts half-way through our main courses. The pork meat balls were savory and soft, the brussels sprouts had the perfect amount of subtle seasoning and butteriness and tasted, well, like elevated brussels sprouts. The cod was where we disagreed---It truly was divine but my partner's complaint was that it was too creamy. I gladly sopped the cream up with their anise-y bread. We also shared a main of mussels, sausage, and sauerkraut that we fought over. 
The bread pudding won for dessert, but we were both too stuffed to finish it, as good as it was. All in all, a fantastic experience.

I'm a regular customer of the Dickey's BBQ located in Dallas where they have wonderful BBQ. 

Today we're very disappointed with the food, so much so that we threw it away.  The pork was awful and the chicken was bad too. 

We'll never venture to Dickey's outside of Texas again.
Very pleased with the poke bowl. Easy to customize and good quality. Very quick service.
The chicken is good but the staff are assholes so I'm not coming back!! I'll give my business to Pelicana or Countrycoco instead

Excellent food and service! If you're looking for authentic tacos this is definitely a must stop. I came here on a weekend about the time it opened and it was not busy. Seating is limited so I imagine during lunch hours this place can get pretty packed. The location looks like it is a house that was converted into a restaurant. I tried the Carnitas, Pastor, Chicken, and Campechano tacos which were all great! They serve a green salsa as well as a red one. Both salsas were delicious and not too spicy. I am definitely coming back to try some of the other items on the menu.

I've had my fair share of pho and never had pho this digusting.I'm definitely not a picky eater.I ordered pho,fried spring roll and crawfish.everything was nasty.Lets just say everything came back out.I feel bad for writing a bad review but this food left a really bad taste in my mouth

This is delicious hot pot, and at such a great price!!
The fishballs with pork were amazing, and especially great in the  schezuan broth!

We were given a gift card and although they weren't yet open for inside dining we thought we'd try it. Glad we did. Today's special dinner was Chinese. Our selection was a shrimp dinner with rice, egg roll, and snow peas. Everything was delicious and prepared to perfection. We'll be back
Best deep fried veggie rolls & sautéed broccoli I've ever eaten! This place never disappoints.

Good home cooked style food. Great service. Good decor. Good value for money. Had stuffed cabbage aka golubci with mashed potatoes for 13$. Three meals with a beer and two wines for 60$. Others had pierogi aka pelmeni.

Where to start. First extremely overpriced for this area. I've been to many other Korean bbq places and never received only one small portion for dinner price of $26!! And we were told we had to order a certain about to sit at the table. We were the only ones there!!! Very rude women who work or own the place. We ordered water to get her away and than left. The prices were insane for the portions and Saturday lunch in Greenwood. Do you research first, spend your money else where. Would have been at least $150 for 4 of us for lunch. Rather spend my money at Fogo.

Started this review and didn't realize I never finished submitting it.

My dad took my family out to dinner for my wife and I's birthdays. This was the first time anyone in our party had eaten Brazilian food. We were excited but nervous.

I'm embarrassed that I don't remember his name, but he was one of the most knowledgeable  servers I've encountered. He was very patient with our questions and indecisiveness, as well as my Dad's dumb comments. He walked us through the menu flawlessly and double-backed a few times for our questions.

All of our food was amazing . We'll be back soon!

The ribs are as good as it gets.  I have decent BBQ experience and I haven't had better anywhere (though Bogarts - same family, different recipe, gives them a run for their money).  Perfectly smoked and a tremendously flavorful rub.  Sauce is available on the side, but don't ruin it with too much sauce.  Have a couple without any sauce first.  

The burnt ends are also quite good.  The other meats are fine, but really don't waste stomach space, just get ribs.  You can get better, pulled pork, brisket etc. plenty of other places. You will not find better ribs.  The sides are also mostly above average.  I wouldn't consider any as stand outs.  The beans are probably the best side option.

I've never been stuck in a long line, though I always go early.  I hear midday on a weekend can be crazy.

We went to Mitchell's Fish Market and had a wonderful Christmas Eve dinner.  The restaurant was nicely decorated and the ambiance was wonderful for a festive occasion.  My wife got the Bourbon Glazed Salmon for $28.  This is a holiday seasonal item.  It came with roasted root vegetables and maple bacon butter.  She said it was excellent.  I got the Crab Cake and Shrimp combo for $25.  It came with a roasted corn sauté and smashed redskin potatoes.  It was wonderful as well.  We both got a side house salad, which was very large for a side salad.  It was made with quality fresh greens.

Our server was pleasant and friendly.  It took a bit longer than expected for our food to arrive.  However, it was Christmas Eve and the place was reasonable full.  Our server kept checking back and apologized a few times for the delay.  We were not in a hurry and were enjoying the atmosphere and occasion.  Given the date and circumstances, I am not counting this against them at all.  We like to go out to eat at a "nice" restaurant on Christmas Eve (no dirty dishes or kitchen to clean! LOL).  We have been to Mitchell's on two separate Christmas Eves and would return again!

Mitchell's also has a wonderful Happy Hour menu in the bar area.  And it is even available on Fridays!  Obviously, we did not partake of this on Christmas Eve but I thought I would mention that fact as well.  We enjoy having a drink in a bar booth, splitting a couple of the Happy Hour food items for dinner, and then continuin

Sitting here for our 2nd night in a row! The drinks are exceptional and most of them made with fresh ingredients. The food is amazing! Only reason we aren't eating dinner here again is due to budgets. We took the advice of our waitress and ordered her favorites, the steak medallions and shrimp and grits, both blew us away! I'm from Louisiana, so I know shrimp and grits...I've had better, but to be in the West and get good shrimp and grits is tough to master. The steak medallions had the most delicious flavors. Will come here every time we are in Boise!

The sesame chicken was the best that we have ever had. And we have eaten at lots of different restaurants. We will definitely go back there again. The portions are a great size also. We have told all our friends about this place. Fabulous!

The food here was really good! the service was excellent! And the portions were very large and can be shared. I had the basil fried rice and potstickers. It was really delicious and the plate presentation was spectacular I almost did not want to deconstruct it but I was starving lol.

We had Sam as our server! She was amazing. There was a problem with the table we first sat at, but we were quickly reseated and received free apps! With our big group, she efficiently handled all of our orders, and the food was excellent.

I've been here a few more times since my initial review and I'm ready to bump it to four stars. The vegan rancheros are amazing and there's something simply amazing about the black beans. On my last visit, I decided to add vegan pancakes to my meal and they were absolutely amazing, although we expected plain pancakes but received blueberry pancakes instead. 

I would bump to five stars based on food alone but I don't like all the up charges...  $2 to add tofu or eggs to the rancheros, $1 for plant milks, $2 to make the pancakes vegan. It all kinda adds up and feel out of place for a place that is clearly going out of its way to cater to vegan diets.

I ordered red lobster for Uber eats tonight. I was in the mood for crab legs. I bought 1.5 lbs. they were the smallest crab legs I have ever seen. I have worked in foodservice my whole life and I do not even know where you can buy them so small. I expected better than a Chinese buffet but was sorely mistaken.

This restaurant has so much potential.  Having dined here a few times, I always hope that the service will get better.  Sadly, it doesn't.  The food is amazing, but the waitstaff is either untrained, or understaffed.  We walked out after 10 minutes of being sat and ignored.   The restaurant could possibly use a consultant to help better engage the customers

While waiting for my lunch @ the Indy airport, I just watched the expeditor pull a hair from her cheek, show the other girls how long it was & report, " I've been growing that my whole life!"

I discarded the bag as soon as it was handed to me as I was SO grossed out. I tried the comment address website listed on receipt but it wouldn't come up on my phone

I don't give five stars often.  The prices, food selection, and quality was awesome.  The place is small and busy.  But the French toast was amazing.  Fluffy and really good.  The waitress was friendly and sweet.  I like eating at the counter.  Definitely will be a repeat!

Tried to order very basic foods such as the trio appetizer nachos and fajitas and immediately got a message saying they couldn't for fill my order via DoorDash. I've ordered from them multiple times and this is the first time I've had that issue. so disappointed and now I have to wait for the temp charge to get removed.

Roast pork delicious..melt in your mouth 
The best I've ever ate. 
Duck yummy so soft & tender 
All pastries yummy 
Love the fresh tofu drink 
Overall I love this place

We were seated quickly, food was great. The portions are HUGE. We ordered an appetizer and weren't able to finish all of our entrees because we were so stuffed. Everything our family ordered was delicious. The atmosphere is family-friendly and fun. Great place to watch sporting events on the projection screen, and enjoy live music. I personally recommend the fish tacos. They're by far the best in TI /SPB area. So yummy!

Got Uber eats from here tonight.  VERY good.  Moussaka was good but could use more seasoning.  Falafel themselves were wonderful but the sandwich lacked 'stuff'.  Mixed shwarma was wonderful.  Baklava was awesome.

Fantastic experience. Hostess greeted us at the entrance by name. Service was impressive, food was great. House has a greet ambience. I would definitely recommend dressing up and going to the Standard House.

First time customers and we were pleasantly surprised at how delicious it was.  Fast & friendly service.  So many choices it was hard to decide which entree to choose!  We will definitely be back to sample more items.  One of us had the make your own omelette with grits & an English muffin.  The other had the shrimp & grits w/ Tasso sausage & cheese.  That one was very tasty!
They are open until 2 pm every day so we look forward to our next visit.
Haven't had a bad meal from there yet, although on Sunday it's usually a wait out the door to get seated, but the food And drinks are all good!

My first time here was great. The place is clean and the service was by far better than the competition (Burger King, McDonald's, KFC, and Etc). The Honey Chicken sandwich was outstanding!!!!! Def go to this place instead of one of the major chains. They should have one in every town! Top 3 best chicken tenders I've ever had! Also, I'm a sauce guy and the fact that they have MANY to choose from is always challenging and delightful! I will be a frequent customer!

(Pre- COVID-19 Review) For a seriously amazing PEPPERONI PIZZA, check out Bettina's take at the Montecito Country Mart. Not only do they use the same pepperoni served at New York's Prince Street Pizza, they also don't skimp on it. Literally every bite I had, had pepperoni. And all that savory goodness is balanced with the sweetness of Ojai wildflower honey. I also really liked their charred, yet chewy crust.

Great place to stop at if you're travelling between Santa Barbara and Los Angeles.
I went to First Watch. They had some rude staff. So, I was referred to Turning Point from an online review. The food was fresh and the staff is very helpful and friendly.

This was my second visit. I was really hoping things would have improved from my first. 

We were told it would be 30-40 min for a table(no problem), so we went to the bar for a drink while we waited.  The bar was a dirty, unorganized, and quite frankly unsanitary.  The bartender was completely overwhelmed and undertrained, as the ownership of the restaurant just watched her struggle.  

We were seated at our table, provided with menus, and chips and salsa.  30 minutes after being seated, we realized that being served wasn't going to happen.  We did speak to the manager on the way out, which I fear fell on deaf ears.

I live very close and want to see this beautiful space thrive, but if major changes aren't made soon this place will not survive. 

Save yourself the trouble.... go to Pueblo Solis and enjoy consistently great service, food, and strong drinks.

If you ask anyone in Nashville where to go for breakfast, I'd say like 85% of them will suggest Biscuit Love. Now, while the place is alright, it definitely garners more hype than it deserves. 

A friend and I were visiting Nashville and decided to go out to Biscuit Love for breakfast since so many people suggested it. When we arrived, we ordered our food, got seated, and served our food pretty quickly. We both ordered the East Nasty (Chicken Biscuit topped with Sausage Gravy and Cheddar). Now, I will say the biscuit and chicken breast are pretty big in size so don't feel like you need to order a lot. The presentation of the biscuit is ehh. It's drenched in the gravy so it looks messy but it doesn't - it's like an organized mess if that makes sense. 

It looks promising and almost convinces you it might be the "Best Sandwich in America"... but it's not. The biscuit itself is DRY. The gravy didn't help it much so my friend and I had to use a lot of jelly to give it some taste and eliminate the dryness. The chicken breast was decent but could've used a little more flavor or maybe had some crunch to it. Overall, the sandwich wasn't bad but it definitely doesn't earn the accolades of all the hype.

Side note: The location in The Gulch has the "Nashville What Lifts You Wings" mural.

This restaurant is a gem among other breakfast spots in the Reno area! The food is served in decadent proportions, and is both flavorful and satisfying. The humble space can get busy (which is definitely a good sign), but the hosts were friendly and checked up on our party among the long wait time. When bringing in a large party over 8 people over the weekend, please plan accordingly as the wait may take from 30mins to a 1 hour. But it is assuredly worth the wait. 

The service was efficient and we were greeted by what seemed like every employee in the restaurant, despite the busy brunch rush. They take care of their guests with attentiveness and upbeat attitudes that made us want to keep coming back. 

Finally, the food: large portions, delicious, and at a great price! Not your typical cafe or diner breakfast spot for sure. They have daily and weekly specials, and offer so many sweet and savory dishes. I recommend the chicken fried steak! It was perfectly seasoned and my gravy was served on the side to keep the steak crispy. Accompanied by home fried potatoes, it kept me full and satisfied!

All I can say is WOW! This building is BREATH TAKING! It was built in 1910 and was originally the head quarters for the Nevada-California-Oregon railway. 
As soon as you walk in, you can feel the elegance of this building.  This is definitely a place you want to spend time in. 

The food is mouthwatering and the drinks are to die for. 
The appetizers are a must. We had the corn fritters and Brussel sprouts. Talk about a flavor explosions! 

The Depot also offers an amazing happy hour for apps! Happy hour is from 3-6pm. There are also deals on drinks during happy hour. 

This place is perfect for date night, family and friend gatherings! I just went on a date night and had the most splendid time. 
The Depot has ample space so large groups will not be an issue. 

There is also an outside area and a small parking lot to the side and behind the building. 

Make sure the check out their website to make reservations, book parties, and get more info on this unique Reno distillery/ brew house/restaurant.

We have always been a fan of this place.  As a matter of fact, one of my kids requested this place for his Birthday dinner!  When covid hit---they took the opportunity to do a remodel --and let me tell you-they did an amazing job!  I was impressed.   It looks very nice in there--not so dark and dingy anymore.  They added a dessert bar and an actual bar in the restaurant.  The food remains amazing!  The wait staffs' attitudes remain the same too--wish they were a bit more happy, or at least pretend to be.  I saw probably one waitress that had a smile on her face last night--everyone else looked like they were only there cause they had to be.  They do offer pick up as well as dine in.  Masks are required but did not appear to be specified tables to sit at to promote distancing--however, you now seat yourself, so you can pick how far you want to be from others.  If you have not been there yet--go check it out and treat yourself to the I-10 Belly Buster!!!

We found this restaurant after missing a reservation at another establishment. Best find ever!! The atmosphere is amazing and the service is exceptional. The food was simply incredible. My family cannot stop talking about the great time that we had and how we cannot wait to go back.
Really friendly employees, nice little spot, but do NOT come to this Starbucks if you're in any kind of a rush!

So disappointed. I went to the original Delorenzos in New Jersey for years and the pizza was fantastic. Now that they moved 10 minutes away from my house I should be thrilled. Well I'm not. The pizza was terrible. I keep trying it but I'm done.

I've been here several times and I can attest to the awful service, staff, and wait times others have complained about. However this restaurant has sunk to a new low. When we got there the host was on his computer and said he'd be with us in a minute. We stood there waiting for several minutes feeling largely ignored and clearly less important than whatever he was doing on his computer that just could not wait for 30 seconds. Finally he sat us and we asked to not be seated in Brandon's section. (We've had him as a server every time we've been there, and we never see him after our food is served. We've even had to go up to the counter to ask for our bill after sitting there waiting for him to bring it for 25 minutes after we've finished our meal.) After we sat down I left the table briefly. In that time, apparently the host had gone straight to Brandon and told him we didn't want to sit in his section, because Brandon approached my elderly mother sitting by herself and mocked her by saying "My name is Brandon and I'll be your waiter" with a big smirk on his face and then walked away. When I found out I said if he's immature enough to do something like that then he's immature enough to put something in our food, so we left and dined elsewhere. The fact that he thought it was the right thing to do to treat a customer this way, and was even funny, is appalling. We have a right to ask to sit in someone else's section without fearing retaliation, harassment, or mockery. I've seen t
This place is awesome , great atmosphere and awesome wait staff and food was mind blowing great , definitely a different style but it works and very enjoyable

The burger and fries here are amazing. I havent tried the pizza but I'm sure is very delicious as well. Happy hour also provides bomb deals. 
The reason why the burger is so good is because (I think) its hand made buns. They use a flat bread dough and thicken it for the bun and its sooo good.
I've been here twice, the first time I had no problems and would have given them 5 stars 
But the second time I had pretty bad customer service. It looked like 3 girls were new working there and one girl was teaching them. My bf and I were making separate orders and the lady left to go talk to the 3 girls (not training talk but gossip or something) after my bf ordered, we had to call her back to make the second order. We got our first food, but it was all wrong. We had to go back apparently it wasnt even our food but our buzzer rang and it wasnt ready. Once we got the right order we were waiting on the second order. One of the girls picked up a bag (our food) looked at it and put it back and hid behind the counter, didn't ask anyone for help. Another girl did the same thing and we finally went to ask if that bag was ours and she said "oh yea I was just going to ask if this is your food" but yea... no she wasnt. I'm pretty sure it was going to get cold of we didnt say anything
I get that they might be new but everything was so out of order and the one lady supposed to be supervising was not doing her job. I really did not like the service that day.

Best pizza we have discovered since moving here from Philadelphia 5 years ago.  I am used to the best pies in the U.S.: from New York City and Philadelphia.  It turns out that the cook and owner are FROM New York City! No wonder!  The long drive was worth it to us.

After reading the reviews, we decided to treat ourselves to a nice dinner at this restaurant yesterday afternoon.  We arrived around 5 pm so it wasn't busy.  We were promptly seated and greeted by Kristina who advised us that Josh was a fellow team member.  We ordered our drinks and meals within a few minutes of being seated.  I loved the ambiance.  My spouse decided to have a glass of wine so she placed the order with Kristina after our salads arrived.  Then service went downhill from there...It took 15 minutes to receive her glass of wine and 3 additional trips for sweetener for my iced tea.  The food was impressive, and believe it or not, we will return because the menu was impressive and the prices were very reasonable.  However, coming from a service background (and having lived in Las Vegas, NV for 14 years), loyal customers only remain loyal when service is top notch.  Being down a server - I get it.  However, to me, that means we hustle more to make things happen.  We will try this steakhouse again.

This place has the best wings in the city and amazing pizza. Customer service is great too. They forgot to put blue cheese in with my food and called to tell me they were going to deliver it to my house without me even asking.

We  enjoyed dining here so much that we came back again while we were in town.  The prices are very reasonable, considering the location. The service was great also. Only complaint is they don't blacken the grouper, but it was delicious nonetheless.
My brothers and I are visiting from NYC and DC; we were blown away by this place.  The food and beer are top notch, and chef's commitment to local farms and culinary experiments pays off.  Go here.
Please make sure you check your surroundings here and anywhere you are. Stay safe peeps and read reviews.

Like chipotle but for pizza   This place is awesome pizza was cooked just right customer service was excellent manager came out  to talk to us and went back and made fresh cinnamon rolls for us. They definitely know how to treat a customer
Little gem in Riverview! Good coffee and pastry, I ask for a caffè' macchiato and she master it! I will go back for sure and hope more people will do the same!

Great atmosphere, clean, nice patio with string lights and heaters. Staff was super friendly. I accidentally entered through a side door and was apologetic, but they met me with humor saying "as long as you're here!" and got me seated quickly which was nice. Lauren the bartender was kind, knowledgeable and helpful. We only had drinks and an app but everything that came out looked awesome. Thanks Fat Cat, we'll be back!

Sorry, I am really not a big fan of TCF, 
The steak is literally horrible taste. It's really just a little bit better than fast food. Lol.
Waitress was not wearing a mask. Said she was sweating. Salad was overpriced. Four shrimp in their Shrimp salad. $15. I was not comfortable there at all.

Just left there..This was our first time eating there. Love the decor, service was great , pizza was awesome. The guy that was there gave us a to go menu and even said he would deliver out to our area .Really good  and it's 6 miles from our house,yeah.....

We tried to go here last weekend around 645 and the wait was over an hour! They DO NOT take reservation or call ahead (which is not something I am a fan of). Tonight we decided to come back at 5 on the dot, figuring we could beat the rush. It was definitely worth a second trip! We had such a fabulous waitress, Parker, who definitely added to a great experience. We wanted to try the pepperoni pizza and the potato skins-both which were excellent. 
My husband pointed out that everyone around us was ordering the specials of the weekend-we asked the family next to us who had the special how it was and they said it was great and they always order it-maybe next time. We'll definitely be back. Also, really want to acknowledge our waitress Parker one more time--her energy and excitement for the restaurant was palpable and they are lucky to have her!!
This place sucks DO NOT GO!!! Please pick somewhere else! Slow service and cold food horrible service!!!
Been going to this chick fil a for months now.  Every time they have forgotten something on my order.  It shows up on the receipt but not in the bag.  The staff needs to get act together.

We used a Groupon here and was told that we would have to pay a 21% tip in order to use it. So they add the tip to the non discounted portion of the check and then added the coupon. So watch out for them. Food ok coffee was really good. Service just ok.

Waited for an excessive amount of time for an order. They didn't have my order in the system when I asked someone and they had to put the order in fresh. No one was around to help. Very poor experience

Update- owner replied. Tried again. Same problems/frustrations.
Great place.  Food is excellent and reasonably priced.  Plenty of parking as well. There is also outside seating in a shaded area out front.

Best meal we've had in Tampa! We have been here for a year and tried several restaurants in the Tampa area. On Swann has greats atmosphere, amazing food, great service, and the Hyde Park neighborhood is awesome. Loves all of it.

Been in a few times to this ridiculously cool speakeasy, and let me tell you it's always a blast! Great cocktails, amazing cigar selection and probably the best pizza in Nashville area! The staff is super knowledge and friendly. If you our on a date and want to impress them, I'd definitely take them here

I would give this two stars based on the quality of the doughnuts. Was expecting them to have a bit more flavor and be a little less dry. Bumped up a star because the service was exceptional, and the cashier was super friendly, but not in a cheesy way.

I couldn't find a thing to complain about if I wanted to. Who knew the coolest taco place in Nashville was in Donelson? As a new resident of the "Hip D" lol, I'm proud as hell. I came with my 5 year old niece and she was super impressed as well. I still can't believe I really enjoyed a root vegetable taco with goat cheese. The outside area is a whole vibe and I will be back to try other dishes and libations.
Great food, service and fun atmosphere. My husband and I really enjoyed our first visit and we will be back for more!  Best cheesesteak and garlic rolls.
The food was amazing and the customer service was awesome . I don't know the gentleman name but the African American man with the locks was the best person ! This place is # Bay Area certified

Well, sometimes you have to make a place work for you.

All of the potential convenience woes mean nothing if they're forced to make you a new delicious batch. Just order a ton of chicken for delivery and this place is absolutely aces.  Chicken was fresh, well seasoned, and juicy as a waterfall.

You don't order swordfish at a steakhouse or calamari at a burger joint: Why  have inflated expectations on anything other than their specialty?

The chicken is great and you can get it delivered to you still crackling in their crisper bags for a TON cheaper and tastier than KFC or Popeyes (both of whom use buckets/boxes that mean a soggier end product).  

KFC 16 piece = $32.39
Popeyes 16 piece = $30.79
Royal Farms 16 piece = $20.00 (or 27.98 if you want lots of white meat).

That's right.  It costs $10.79 less than its closest competitor via Doordash. Which means it's actually *even* more economical because lower cost = lower fees + lower tip.  

It tastes like the oil they use is new.  I only know this because of the comparison (and decades of experience): neither KFC or Popeyes taste like they use new oil with each batch unless you get lucky.

By far, the best sushi out there!  We've been here twice and will definitely be making the far 2 hour (+) drive, just to have it again!  Not only was the sushi fantastic, but the staff makes you feel welcome, not a burden, like every other sushi place I've been to.  The waitresses were great, and we can't wait to plan another trip up!

Worst service ever! The gal working the drive thru was so rude! She acted like she didn't even hear me but I heard through the speaker all of them laughing! This place needs to be closed down! That is a horrible way to treat a disabled person that had an elderly person in the car who could not speak due to a stroke so I was the go between. I tried to pull around and go inside but the dining room was uncharacteristically closed at early evening! Never going back! I would not recommend this place at all. They disrespect folks with disabilities! Awful!!!!!!

Came by on a weekend night so it's quite busy. First up - everyone has to wear a mask, staff too. Tables outside distanced. Between each customer they do a thorough clean down of table and chairs. 
Ok the good stuff - the food. The lobster tacos very good, as are the chicken ones. Guacamole was ok. The blood orange margarita was delicious.

Holy cow was this place incredible. The restaurant is so beautifully decorated and the food is absolutely delicious. The chapati was perfect, the daal was yummy, and the paneer was simply outstanding. The people working are so kind, quick, and really want you to get something that you'll enjoy. I'm so glad that this was recommended by a friend, I'll be back time and time again!

Nice little joint. Will return often.

Has inside and outside bars/seating. Lots of TVs and the inside booths have outlets for all your charging needs. 

Visited twice so far - the nachos were amazing and big portion size. Had plenty of chicken/beans/cheese to match the large serving of chips. I was hungry and couldn't finish it. Second trip got the wings. I give them a B. The sauce is more cooked on rather than dipped so your fingers stay cleaner.

Big beer selection - everyone should be able to find one they like.

Went for lunch, the wait stay was very cordial and pleasant.

I ordered the Club, which is a gigantic turkey filled sandwich with avocado, bacon, tomato, bibb (lettuce), Swiss cheese, and a garlic aioli which takes the sandwich over the top. It's a beast of a sandwich, and it's worth every penny.

The plate came with a side of "spicy" sweet potato fries... and they're awesome. It's not an overwhelming spice, it's just a nice mouth heat that lingers a few seconds after the swallow.

The business isn't just a food joint, there's a small book store, a sunglass hut, a walk-up coffee bar, and a several other small attractions.

My other 3 companions also had a similarly stellar meal and experience. Highly recommend the food and the business as a whole.
I love eating here. Friendly , clean and GOOD! I'm a negimaki fan.... theirs is the best ! My daughter loves their sushi.... interesting rolls and specialties ! I highly recommend it

This is hands down the best place to get a steak in STL. They have out of this world risotto (seriously the absolute best I pretty much lived on it during my pregnancy since my husband works around the corner )

I don't know if the food was worse or Tilla the chick at the drive thru. She is rude, sounds likes she hates her job, and has 0 customer service skills. If I was management I would fire her for the disrespect she causes while taking drive thru orders. Food tasted reheated as well.
Food was great and service was even better.  Lots of meat on the subs and the fries were good.  Kids loved the fried Oreos
The food is very yummy portion size or large and the beverages are really good also if you haven't had a vegetarian dish give it a try you won't miss the meat.

It doesn't matter how awesome you are it's 2020 u don't get to charge for Wi-Fi. It's akin to charging extra for a toilet.  It's base line expected. Staff is awesome rooms are great. But doesn't  matter when I'm paying 400 plus a night and get cut arched for Wi-Fi. It's just sooooo generic for a high end hotel to do.

We have gone to this location twice now and both times it's been an issue to try and get seated. They all run around like they don't have clue. Our waitress was friendly but it seems as if they are not training their people properly. Even the manager stood around looking like a deer in headlights.
Don't think wwe will be going back until  they can get theIr act together.

Inconsistent
This place has so much potential. It's either good or not good. Hit or miss. Great location for a drink and a salad
Once again bartenders Sara and Mark made me and my family feel right at home. Great service, prices and food make us come back year after year. The best on the beach without question.

I was craving Poke, I read a friends review of IjjI Noodle House and decided to check it out. So I had my Poke & I made my taste buds happy! Honey seasoned chicken wings not on the menu yet ($7.95) & simple white rice for my daughter which of course she devoured! My Poke bowl of scallops, tuna & salmon over brown rice w/avocado,  cucumber, green onions, sesame/red pepper flakes & wonton chips($11.95)... oh my goodness, just delicious!  

The service was great and the place is right in my neighborhood so I will be back!
It is our first time.  The food was total disappointment.  We ordered the egg white omelette, it came with some roasted sweet potato and pinion drowned in oil.  The fried chicken was very greasy.

The Disco "Chicken" sandwich had me hooked for quite some time with its smokey tempeh, flavorful grilled mock meat, and plenty of pickles and aioli. I hadn't had one for a long time until the other evening. It perfectly satisfied my craving. The cilantro black bean dip is probably the best fry dip I've ever had. It's got depth and flavor. The savory flavor is a great contrast to the sweet sweet potato. The food always comes out fresh and in a reasonable amount of time. Water is self serve which makes it easy. 

The food here is four stars all the way, but the prices have gotten way too high. Now, for a sandwich, fries, and tap water, it's a little over $15 with tax for a restaurant that doesn't offer table service. This is something I can't justify doing very often. I wish they'd make the fries in a smaller size offering as well. I usually can't finish them, but without them, I am still hungry. I could save money and calories if they offered other sizes.

To expensive 16.45 for a carne asada burro and a drink lemonade  and the food it's not great the meat was very dry and the lemonade tested so bad like sugar the employees are really confused we the orders and the take 20 min to give me my order to go

Honestly I was so excited to try this place specifically the  Sunday gravy. The only reason why I'm even leaving two stars is Bc the service was great, fast, and presentation of the food was nice. But man the meal was awful
And I am not a picky eater. The rigatoni was undercooked bad and the sauce was almost unbearable. Lacking flavor besides too much salt. I felt like I was eating a crushed salty tomato. I am not sure if I caught them on a bad day so I may try them in the future just a different meal, but I was just so disappointed.

This is a favorite of ours.
The seats are extremely comfortable  ! The service and the food 
is great. We never have had an issue. Having ability to reserve your seats saves a ton of stress on having to get to the theatre  early

Highly recommend !

Meh. I got the south of the border salad which is their specialty. To be honest it was nothing special. The dressing was sour and kind of yucky. I did like the pretzel bun though. And corn bread was delicious as well. The ordering process was extremely disorganized. Instead of having a large menu display a paper menu was passed from one person to another. I guess they didn't get the memo that everyone in the world is trying to minimize contact between people. I might try something on their breakfast menu next time we are in St Louis. But overall I won't recommend.

Bagel Deli is by far my favorite place to eat in Broad Ripple. From the friendly service to the quality of the food, it is a home run for anyone looking for a delicious, filling, and reasonably priced meal. The only problem you can face here is the wait, especially if you go on weekend mornings as everyone that was in Broad Ripple the night before seems to return to indulge in a hearty breakfast. My favorite options are the roadkill, the morning mess, and the 5-0 but also have gone for lunch for one of their other options. The restaurant itself is also always playing good music providing a fun, yet chaotic, atmosphere as dozens of orders are rapidly taken. It is the best option for anyone looking for a weekend cheat meal and I highly recommend it to everyone in the area.

I had an AMAZING birthday dinner with friends while on our recent visit to New Orleans. Everyone was super friendly and helpful. The place was super clean and organized. The food was incredible! The garlic butter shrimp boil was delicious. The manager even sent over a complementary hot garlic shrimp boil for us and it was delicious as well. I'm not a huge corn and red potato person so I loved that these were served over fries. After our meal we were led through the back distillery area where they had some shirts and hats and mechanize to choose from. We also bought some rum. I 100% recommend this place. We took the street car over and enjoyed the sights in the neighborhood as well.

Very cool place.  Friendly people with blues music playing.  Get here early because there a line.  You know its good when u see S t Louis PD the coast guard and Fire dept all there for lunch.  I had the muffalletta and it rivals Central Grocery.

Food was delicious! Service was excellent. Called for a reservation and was told couldn't get in until 7:30, but looked online and a reservation was available at 6:30 so I made the reservation online and went earlier. 

My friend and I were in town for a girls weekend and ended up eating there both nights! I had the salad the first night which was huge and very tasty. Croutons were massive and had a unique taste to them. Second night I got steak and baked potato. Steak was tender and cooked just the way I liked it. I've been to three different J Alexander's restaurants and would definitely go to them any time I'm near one.

I don't have any clue as to how this place gets such a high rating. When we entered it was empty, red flag! The health department should go in there. The cheese was so old I could only take one bight. My brother got a burger, same thing so he took the meat off the bread and couldn't swallow the meat. My kid liked the fries so we got a few fries for $40.00. Not to mention the whole staff of three stayed outside smoking and coming right back in to cook and when they were done right back outside. The waitress should have seen one bite and asked what was wrong, not here. The staff was friendly, but why or how would they serve something so terribly bad to people? Needs a real deep clean to take out the wet dog smell. I would not recommend to anyone

The best brisket I've ever had! My wife and I came here for a late lunch and had a nice surprise! Everything was excellent! The brisket was super tender and hardly had any fat on it! All of the sides were absolutely delicious from the collared greens to the corn bread. Would definitely recommend!

Food and service both amazing. To be fair I haven't had too many things here. The lamb shank was a bit below par. The plates are incredible though. I get the gyro, chicken and sausage platter. The salad is awesome. Everyone is super friendly and welcoming.

As you can probably tell, I love bagels. These bagels are pretty darn good. I usually get an everything bagel, which definitely does not ever skimp on seasoning (which is awesome). The breakfast sandwiches are decent, however the real money items that I have gotten are the Chicken salad sandwich and the Western Club. The combinations that they have that involve the different flavors of cream cheese are really the bomb. It is a bit expensive, however well worth it as the lunch sandwiches are HUGE. Its definitely worth a stop!

The food and drinks were flavorful but the service and atmosphere negatively impacted the experience. The server didn't know how to describe the menu items to us and we had a lot off wait time during our dining experience as well.  The cleaner used on the tables also made it sticky. Ambiance is okay.

Amazing! Great pizza wow, I should say exceptional... mostly a takeout place, so fun to just swing by and enjoy the food, owner, pizza thrower, and great prices!!! You can't go wrong. Thank you Tony!!!!!! We will be back with lots of friends!
Debbie and Sheena are the best bartending staff on Sundays!  and made our drinks super good!  very personable and polite

Love this sweet place! The best desserts ive ever had and the employees are kind and thoughtful. My favorites are the coconut and black out slices.  And they are very thoughtful when enforcing masks. Keeping our sweet tooth happy and safe. We will be back!

Very disappointed on Saturday Night, I've been to Big Lug on 86th a couple times and had a great meal.  This one not so much.  They should rename the Poutine, Bootine.  Worst I've ever had.  Service was horrible as well.  Won't be back.  Now questioning whether to support the other locations.

This is definitely a buffet to go to when you are either: visiting Reno, Going by Reno, or if you just live there! This buffet is personally the best buffet in Reno! If you are going on a romantic date, go by the pasta section and get some fresh spaghetti or ravioli. If you're hungry in the morning, go to the breakfast section which included eggs Benedict, sausage, waffles, pancakes, and who doesn't love bacon! Great for vegetarians as well. There is a nice salad bar and awesome world options. Nice for anyone from the health conscious people, to the ones who just can't wait to get all you can eat crab on crab night and prime rib! Even fun for the kids! They have fresh fruit, juice, cake, ice cream and even more. They even hit the spot with the service! The waiters/waitresses are always happy to help and will bring you what you need. The list is endless, but make sure you consider going here if you want to eat in a buffet. (P.S. Happy New Years! 2020)

I was staying at the nearby hotel and my colleague mentioned this place so we ended up chilling here.
We ordered the 5 sampler beer... our waitress, Cassandra... was a super resource. She asked me what I was into and she explained that she had quite the variety of beer to offer. I let her choose the beers for me ams trust me she did an awesome job!
We topped off the order with some wings... can't go wrong with the comfort food.
It was the perfect combo. I will have to pay for it at the gym tomorrow but... sometimes.. you just have to splurge!
Thanks to Cassandra and her colleagues for giving us an outstanding experience at the Pint N Beer!
So, if you re ready to chill... this is a nice lil spot!

So I'm vegetarian, which probably means I have very little (to no) business going through a Popeye's drive-thru or eating anything that has to do with Popeye's. I won't even disagree, because I know it's true. That's fine, I'll live. This was all in the name of science, anyways.

I was doing a biscuit comparison amongst a few fast food chains (yes, these are the types of things food journalists right, it's pretty great). I'vee seen enough about Popeyes to know I couldn't neglect and, well, the brand got me at my most vulnerable: watching old Popeye's cartoons. I love that muscly sailor.

The service is whatever. So is the biscuit. To say I was disappointed would be playing it veeeeeeery nicely. Isn't New Orleans KNOWN for its butter-laden biscuits (amongst other things)? To be fair, this is a Popeye's in Carmel, IN- I had low expectations to begin with. But I really didn't think I could be disappointed with what I had set.

I won't go back. Practically ever. I think you can guess why.

I tried it but thought it did not have enough fallback options - perhaps a little too eclectic. I thought the fried fish was gross. The cheesecake was just OK. The waffle was good but the syrups were all out right after opening. I was there for movie night which was an interesting feature. I started smelling really strong cigarette smoke while there so I left early. I felt it seemed overpriced for potentially gross food..

I wanted to break from the usual burrito, pizza, or Chinese (all local, of course) and heard about this place, popular for pupusas (which I've never had). 

I ordered the #1 combo and got a chicharrón pupusa with rice and black beans. The pupusa is a stuffed flatbread that's almost like a thicker version of a quesadilla using masa instead of flour (wheat). The dough itself isn't as flavorful as masa used in the form of a tamale but it holds everything together nicely. The chicharrón wasn't too fatty and the cheese mixture of mozzarella and queso fresco worked, although I was expecting something like a cotija or Monterey in place of mozzarella. It came with a pickled cabbage/carrot relish (curtido) and salsa, with just enough kick. 

Overall very unique flavors I'd never tried before! The rice was flavorful and the black (refried?) beans were smoky. I thought the regular would be a bit small, but with plenty of filling and the sides, you get a good meal for around $10. I  would say my first experience of Salvadorian food won't be my last as I'll need to go back and try a tamale and maybe some plantains. Definitely give this unique local place a try!
What a joke, insanely slow for something that comes out of a machine. 30+ min and doesn't answer phone... Come on
Always wonderful.  Supporting local dining on the day that the pre-Christmas closures were announced.  So glad to experience safe abs delicious indoor dining, while we can!

Been going there for a while as I live close by and there are not very many options for pizza. This will be the last time I'm treated rudely by "max" (the older man who works in takeout) on numerous occasions he has been very rude and short. This last time I simply asked if they were going to be closing and he looked at me in a very threatening manner and asked why I would think that. I was appalled by the way he spoke to me and would never consider giving them any of my business in the future. The food is overpriced and mediocre. Watch out for the owner "Max" I have found hair in my food and he looked at me like I was crazy and was very rude to me. This will be the last time I ever give them my money. I would definitely think twice before visiting this establishment.

Why 3 stars?

I was excited after the reviews so went in for lunch. 

I was blown away with the old decor (not in a good way). I was also the youngest patron by about 20 years and was led to a wobbly table and dusty overhead light.

My server was great, she is the good part.

The Crab soup was so thick my spoon stood up by itself. Could only get a couple bites before I gave up.

Ordered the lunch special prime rib and baked potato. It came out in 2 minutes and 10 seconds. Fastest meal ever. Which is a little scary. 

Prime rib was ok, but nothing to rave about and the baked was great. 

I won't be going out of my way to return. This spot needs a makeover bad.

The food here is delicious . We are a family of 4 with 2 males and we ordered a family meal with the rib tips and whole chicken . The food was great ! We chose the sweet potato fries and baked beans as the sides and they were very good . We will definitely be going back!

Really good food. The ambience is the most romantic, but the food and the service make up for it. 

Spring rolls were fresh and light
The brisket banh mi was ridiculously good. The best 5 bucks you can spend. 
Shrimp lo mein was amazing, surprised by the massive portion. 
Classic pho was great. Perfect for a colder day.

Very good pizza!! Done just the way we asked for! The delivery driver was friendly! The chicken parmigiana and the meatball parmigiana is very good too! Next time will have to try the pasta dishes! First time we found good New York pizza in Tampa took a while to find one but this was a great choice we will be using  them again for sure!!!!

I'm not exaggerating when i say that this is mine and my husbands favorite restaurant in the Brandon/Riverview area. I know it's a pub so it should be about drinks but i have to say every single food item they have is amazing. This is a brand new place, only a few months old, but it's already #1 for us. Their wings and veggie burger are our favorite things to get! You should for sure try them out.

Everyone should try their hazelnut torta - saying that it's amazing is an understatement.

Their sourdough bread is good well. 

Next time I would want to try their garlic bread for sure. 

The pizza and food were good but nothing extraordinary about it. The staff there is really nice and friendly.
